verdicts.reason: A: product in a full circle is large and balanced, quote text bigger and legible. Flaws: the logo is jammed next to the attribution on one line, so brand and credit read as one cluster. The quote block sits low and tight against the bottom, and the quote mark floats with a big gap above it. B: clean left-to-right flow, and the logo has its own spot bottom-left like the original. Flaws: the product circle is clipped at the right and bottom edges, the product is small, and the quote text is smaller. The quote mark is detached from the text, and the left block is top-heavy with dead space.
